high_level_description: The image shows a single wooden chair with a modern design. The chair has a high backrest made of vertical wooden slats that are evenly spaced and aligned vertically. The seat is upholstered with a light beige or tan fabric, providing a soft contrast to the dark wood of the frame. The legs of the chair are also made of the same dark wood material, with a simple, straight design that supports the seat and backrest. The background of the image is plain white, which makes the chair stand out prominently.
